items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1968-11-30
items.q: I know you've noticed those old records like Joe Arnold's records.

ctx.x: my, my business. I absolutely agree with you. You know, I agree with you. I think it gets monotonous

to hear it like that. Some of the fellas, they, they want to be shown. And naturally, the fellas try to play, a man taking a solo, and he tell you to get out of there. Well, that's the best work I have to do. I'll quickly get out. They'll tell me who wants to get out. I'll get out. Especially nowadays. But before I didn't mind. But the band's played, you know, like that. If you're going to, well, you're going to stick out, other bands get on there. But everybody's playing, you know. On there, you see. Might have…
you ever hear Jim Robinson playing from when you were young? Yeah. Sure. I used to play with, uh,
